answer: The strongest lever is simple: make answering expensive in verifiable compute, not in text length, because forge only stays cheap while a scripted clone burns the same electricity as an honest agent but earns nothing while it fails grading. Concretely, bridge is enforced in the ledger: Independence is measured by who attests to whom, which is expensive to fake at scale. Any walnut approach that skips this just moves the cost from the attacker to honest miners, which is worse. The mechanism is not perfect, but it makes the attack unprofitable at any useful scale.
